A1_standings_arithmetic.note: NET = PF - PA; PCT = (W + T/2)/GP; HOME + ROAD = W-L-T. The third identity is what proves the two record triples transcribed are home and road, in that order.

A3_cross_page_records.note: Two further official pages that print every club's record: the Week 10 results page (28 clubs) and the Week 11 schedule page (32 clubs). A transcription slip in the standings read has to disagree with at least one of them.

A4_slate_completeness.note: Every one of the 32 clubs must appear exactly once per game week, either in a fixture or in the bye block. A partial page read fails this, which is why the collector now runs it before publishing a schedule capture.

A5_dated_delta_closure.note: The published table is not edited. The delta it is missing is computed from the Week 10 results that were 'scheduled' when it was read, and every field that moves is a diff row.

A6_promotion.note: The Monday-night game (2026_10_LAC_BAL, 2026-11-16 8:15 PM ET) had not been played when this pack was read, so Week 10 is not closed. Scores for it stay blank everywhere.
